staff.suspended: The school is read only. Contact platform support.
staff.suspendedUntil: Blocked until {date} ({days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left). Everything is read only — contact platform support.
staff.closedTitle: This school is in the archive
staff.closed: The school is archived and will be deleted. Contact platform support to bring it back.
staff.closedUntil: In the archive until {date} ({days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left), then its materials are deleted. Contact platform support to bring it back.

student.suspended: You can still read your courses and see your history, but starting and handing in work is paused.
student.suspendedUntil: You can still read your courses and see your history, but starting and handing in work is paused.
student.closed: The school's courses are no longer available. Your own history stays with you.
student.closedUntil: The school's courses are no longer available. Your own history stays with you.

maintenance.unmaintainedHint: The author no longer updates this course.
maintenance.obsoleteHint: This course is outdated and takes no new learners.
maintenance.label: Maintenance
maintenance.hint: Tell learners whether you still look after this course.
maintenance.learnerNote: This course is no longer maintained: it may be out of date.
maintenance.learnerObsoleteNote: This course is outdated and takes no new learners. You can carry on with it.
maintenance.learnerObsoleteHistoryNote: The school that ran this course is gone: it stays only as your history, and new exercises cannot be started.

errors.schoolNotActiveTitle: The school is not accepting new work
errors.schoolSuspended: The school is temporarily blocked: new work cannot be started or handed in, and nothing in it can be changed.
errors.schoolClosed: The school is closed. Its materials are no longer available.
errors.courseObsolete: This course is outdated and takes no new enrolments.

unavailable.title: School unavailable
unavailable.body: The school is closed, does not exist, or you have no access to it. Your learning history stays with you.
unavailable.courseForbiddenBody: This course belongs to a school that has been closed, or you have not been given access to it. If you studied in that school, your history stays with you.
unavailable.courseGoneBody: The course no longer exists — it was deleted together with its school. Your progress is kept.

readOnly.title: Nothing can be changed right now
readOnly.body: The school is read only. The notice above says why and until when.
readOnly.learnerTask: This task can't be started or handed in right now. The notice above says why; your earlier work is under My work.
readOnly.draftSuspended: Your draft is saved. You can hand it in once the school is unblocked.
readOnly.draftClosed: The school is closed: the draft can no longer be handed in; it stays here to read.
